notes: MERGE NOTES for the Lead — the exact invocation for the post-deployment acceptance run, from a checkout of the deployed revision: bun tests/journey/run.ts --url https://<the-public-preview-url> --environment production --report deploy/evidence/ppr-003-live.json (add ZECK_JOURNEY_TOKEN + ZECK_JOURNEY_APPLICATION_ID for the credentialed sandbox path; the expected revision defaults to the checkout's HEAD, or pin it with --expected-revision <40-hex>). Exit 0 = every executed step passed; the gates[] array maps each program acceptance gate to pass | not-run | fail with its evidence pointer.

The local plane is the bootstrap composition by design (the deploy chain's local mode): it serves the public API route table with the honest 401/422 boundaries and NO HTML experience. The experience-surface steps therefore record not-run with their owner on the local run — the honest fact, never a fabricated pass; against the deployed public preview (which PPR-002 provisions) the same steps run for real. This is the deployment boundary the work order defines: nothing is assumed-pass.

The console's structural assertions (keyboard/focus, responsive plan, reduced motion, navigation, availability disclosure) are deliberately layout-independent: skip link, main landmark, primary nav, aria-current, viewport meta, the 640px/1024px media-query classes, prefers-reduced-motion, and the mandated state vocabulary (available / runnable / provider-gated / requires access / not run) — so the harness survives PPR-001's console reorganization (running in parallel) by construction.

No PostgreSQL server exists in this pod (no psql/initdb binaries, no /usr/lib/postgresql): the work order's pre-authorized no-PG degradation applies. A provisioned run (ZECK_PG_ADMIN_URL, or the deployed preview's Neon authority) records the ready/degraded health states through the same step.
